name: MP Components Inc
old_description: Located in Michigan and Tennessee, MP Components has grown since 1973 from a model and pattern shop into a solid business that is capable of producing Fixtures and Gauges, Models and Patterns, Molds, Match Metal Dies and Special Machines, along with providing Computer Aided Design (CAD) services. Serving a variety of industries, MP Components strives to deliver superior designed, engineered products to its customers giving them a competitive edge.
about:
MP Components Inc. traces its roots to the fall of 1973, when Otto Schlatter and Larry Wiersma founded Model Pattern Company Inc. in Byron Center, Michigan. The shop began as a model and pattern operation, handcrafting prototypes for local manufacturers. In January 1996, the company was renamed MP Components to reflect its expanding capabilities. Today, the business remains family-owned, with the founders' sons, Joe and John Schlatter, leading the second generation from facilities in Byron Center, Michigan, and Cookeville, Tennessee.

The company designs and builds a range of tooling, including checking fixtures (from simple to complex automated units), models and foundry patterns, aluminum vacuum molds, blow molds, foam and compression molds, match-metal trim dies, and special machinery. It also provides computer-aided design (CAD) services, CMM inspection, and CNC machining. Operations span a 28,000-square-foot plant in Michigan and a 10,000-square-foot facility in Tennessee, equipped with current-generation machining and measurement technology.

MP Components serves manufacturers in the automotive, furniture, appliance, aerospace, and medical industries. Its customer base extends across the continental United States, Canada, and Mexico, with the two Midwestern locations positioned for broad geographic coverage.

The founders' original mission — to deliver handcrafted quality models and prototypes — continues to shape the company's approach. MP Components emphasizes a one-stop-shop model for tooling needs, backed by ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 17025 certifications, and highlights rapid turnaround times as a key differentiator.
